sloka: शत्रुघ्नश्चापि तेजस्वी वृक्षानापततो बहून् ।त्रिभिश्चतुर्भिरेकैकं चिच्छेद नतपर्वभिः ।। ७.६९.१० ॥
transliteration: śatrughnaścāpi tejasvī vṛkṣānāpatato bahūn ।tribhiścaturbhirekaikaṁ ciccheda nataparvabhiḥ ।। 7.69.10 ॥

translations.english: And the powerful Shatrughna, with his bent-shafted arrows, cut down each of the many approaching trees with three or four arrows.
